title: Projection
description: A Projection — how to consume. Derived view of facts. Read-only from the client perspective.

id.description: Deterministic ID derived from name + version

consumes.description: The fact types this projection consumes

state.description: Current state derived from consumed facts

factRoot.description: SHA-256 root of all facts that contributed to this projection

stateHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the projection state (RFC 8785 canonicalized)

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp from injected ClockProvider

deprecated.description: Whether this projection has been deprecated
